def generate_output_from_testgrid(test_grid):
    rows = len(test_grid)
    cols = len(test_grid[0])
    output = [[int(v) for v in row] for row in test_grid]
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):

                continue  # 7s stay 7
            has_left = any(test_grid[r][cc] == 7 for cc in range(c))
            has_right = any(test_grid[r][cc] == 7 for cc in range(c+1, cols))
            has_above = any(test_grid[rr][c] == 7 for rr in range(r))
            has_below = any(test_grid[rr][c] == 7 for rr in range(r+1, rows))
            if has_left and has_right and has_above and has_below:

    return output
